new_scholarship.name: UM NL Global Studies Scholarship
new_scholarship.description: Maastricht University awards one full-coverage scholarship per academic year to a bachelor student who has been admitted to its Global Studies bachelor's programme. For 2027-2028 the award covers tuition fees at cost plus a living-expense stipend of EUR 20,150 per academic year, and includes a mandatory two-week UM Pre-Academic Training in the first week of August 2027. Applications are open from 1 October 2026 to 1 February 2027, and the bachelor's programme application in Studielink must be complete by 10 December 2026.
new_scholarship.duration: 36 months (the full three-year Global Studies bachelor's programme)
new_scholarship.application_period: 1 October 2026 - 1 February 2027 (scholarship form); bachelor programme application in Studielink by 10 December 2026
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold the nationality of an OECD Official Development Assistance eligible country (excluding Surinam), must not hold dual EU/EEA, Swiss or Surinamese nationality, must have applied for admission to the Global Studies bachelor's programme for 2027-2028 with a complete file before 10 December 2026, must not already hold a bachelor's-equivalent degree, and must be under 35 years of age on 1 September 2027.

No dual nationality with an EU/EEA country, Switzerland or Surinam
Able to obtain an entry visa and residence permit for the Netherlands

Not older than 35 on 1 September 2027

Living expenses of EUR 20,150 per academic year (EUR 1,550 per month)
Health and liability insurance, at cost
UM Pre-Academic Training costs, at cost

benefits: EUR 20,150 per academic year for living expenses, broken down by Maastricht as housing EUR 960, groceries and personal hygiene EUR 160, telephone EUR 60, travel EUR 100, books and study materials EUR 90, clothing, hobbies and going out EUR 125, miscellaneous EUR 55
A UM room allocated to the scholar until 16 July 2028
Two-week mandatory UM Pre-Academic Training in the first week of August 2027
Participation in the International Student Ambassador Programme

Pay any programme handling fee yourself by 10 December 2026; the scholarship does not cover it

Agree to act as an active Global Studies and UM ambassador during and after the studies, including at least one information session

Proof of academic excellence: latest grade transcript showing at least 75% of the maximum grade

new_scholarship.selection_notes: The UM International Services Desk checks application completeness after 1 February 2027; the Global Studies admission office ranks files on the UM scholarship selection criteria and proposes a top five to the Global Studies Scholarship selection committee in March 2027; the top five are interviewed online; candidates are informed of their status in April 2027, with selected, waitlisted or rejected status final by the beginning of June 2027.

new_scholarship.notes: Only one application may be submitted and documents cannot be replaced afterwards. The scholarship portal is unavailable between 22 and 26 October 2026 during a portal upgrade. The published amounts are stated as subject to change from academic year 2028-2029.

new_scholarship.name: Latvian State Scholarship for Foreign Students (Scholarship for Studies in Latvia)
new_scholarship.description: The Latvian state scholarship for studies pays a monthly stipend to students from more than 30 partner countries who are enrolled in a bachelor's, master's or doctoral programme at a Latvian higher education institution. It is worth EUR 500 per month for bachelor's and master's students and EUR 700 per month for doctoral students, awarded for up to 10 months (11 months for doctoral students). The annual call runs from 1 February to 1 April through the VIAA online application system, so the next window opens on 1 February 2027.
new_scholarship.duration: Up to 10 months for bachelor's and master's students; up to 11 months for doctoral students; maximum two terms within one study cycle
new_scholarship.deadline: 1 April (annual call closes); applications open 1 February
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Citizens of Latvia's more than 30 partner countries may apply. Bachelor's applicants must already have completed at least one academic year at any higher education institution; master's and doctoral applicants may come from any previous institution. Applicants must hold a confirmation letter from the chosen Latvian higher education institution and may not hold another grant concurrently.

new_scholarship.selection_notes: All applications are evaluated against the published quality evaluation criteria and the final decision on granting scholarships is made by the VIAA evaluation committee. Candidates receive an official decision by email in June, also visible in their profile in the electronic application system.
new_scholarship.best_fit: A student from a Latvia partner country who has already completed at least one year of higher education and has secured a place on a study programme at a Latvian higher education institution.
new_scholarship.notes: The scholarship does not cover all study-related costs: some tuition fees, living costs and other expenses must be covered personally, travel expenses to and from Latvia are not covered, and insurance must be arranged by the holder. The stipend level for second-cycle programmes is set at EUR 500 per month under Cabinet Regulation No. 68 of 24 January 2012, as amended by Cabinet Regulation No. 298 of 26 May 2026.
